title: The Leaning Tower of Panels source construction record
construction: An original self-contained tower uses generated painted panels on a six- or eight-sector cylinder. Only a 120-degree front arc is rendered. Panel identity combines a numbered destination floor with one generated segment of a continuous multi-band mural. Scrambles are selected from reachable states and a bidirectional breadth-first search records the exact optimum; the independent grader recomputes that optimum and replays every cylindrical slide.
license_note: No third-party image, audio, font, code, or other presentation asset is bundled. All visuals are repository-authored Canvas, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript primitives. The cited sources supplied interaction ideas only.
